title: Dividends from foreign companies and foreign funds: 25%

source.title: Income Tax Ordinance, s.125B(1); Tax Authority guide 2025 p.116, "שיעורי המס מההכנסות בשנת המס 2026"

rate.notes: Dividends from foreign companies and funds: 25% (30% for a substantial shareholder in the paying company, not stored here). Listed in the 2026 Tax Authority table as "דיבידנד מחברות זרות- 25%, 30%". Budget-sensitive rate.
